changeSet.author: fiter
changeSet.comment: Add job_processed_entity table to manage error while processing Loans/Savings items
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE job_processed_entity ( id int8 GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL, job_id int8 NOT NULL, execution_date DATE NOT NULL, entity_type CHAR(1) NOT NULL, entity_id int8 NOT NULL, execution_process VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, installment_nr int8 NOT NULL, start_time timestamp NOT NULL, end_time timestamp NOT NULL, status char(1) NOT NULL default '1', error_message text NULL, error_log text NULL, CONSTRAINT job_processed_entity_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id) ); CREATE INDEX "scheduledjobsprocessedentityFK" ON job_processed_entity USING btree (job_id);
